iso27001_clauses.title: Introduction
iso27001_clauses.summary: Provides an overview of the standard, explains the Plan-Do-Check-Act (PDCA) cycle, and describes the integration of the Information Security Management System (ISMS) with business processes.
requirements: Understand the need for an ISMS
Familiarize with the PDCA model applied to ISMS processes
Consider the importance of aligning ISMS with organizational objectives

iso27001_clauses.title: Scope
iso27001_clauses.summary: Specifies requirements for establishing, implementing, maintaining, and continually improving an ISMS. It includes requirements for assessing and treating information security risks tailored to the needs of the organization.
requirements: Apply requirements to all types of organizations (e.g., commercial, government, non-profit)
Meet all requirements if claiming conformity to the standard

iso27001_clauses.title: Normative references
iso27001_clauses.summary: Lists referenced documents. ISO/IEC 27000 provides the overview and vocabulary.
requirements: Refer to ISO/IEC 27000 for terms and definitions

iso27001_clauses.title: Terms and definitions
iso27001_clauses.summary: Provides definitions of key terms used throughout the standard.
requirements: Refer to ISO/IEC 27000 for the complete list of terms and definitions

iso27001_clauses.title: Context of the organization
iso27001_clauses.summary: The organization must determine external and internal issues relevant to its purpose and strategic direction that affect the ISMS. It must identify interested parties, their requirements, define the scope, and establish the ISMS.
requirements: Determine external and internal issues relevant to information security
Determine whether climate change is a relevant external issue (Amd 1:2024)
Identify interested parties and their information security requirements
Note: Interested parties may have requirements related to climate change (Amd 1:2024)
Define the scope of the ISMS considering issues, interested parties, and interfaces
Establish, implement, maintain, and continually improve the ISMS

iso27001_clauses.title: Understanding the organization and its context
iso27001_clauses.summary: The organization shall determine external and internal issues that are relevant to its purpose and that affect its ability to achieve the intended outcomes of its ISMS.
requirements: Determine external issues (legal, technological, competitive, market, cultural, social, economic, environmental)
Determine internal issues (values, culture, knowledge, performance)
Determine whether climate change is a relevant issue (Amd 1:2024)
Monitor and review information about these issues

iso27001_clauses.title: Understanding the needs and expectations of interested parties
iso27001_clauses.summary: The organization shall determine interested parties relevant to the ISMS and the requirements of these interested parties.
requirements: Identify interested parties relevant to the ISMS
Determine their information security requirements
Consider which requirements will be addressed through the ISMS
Note: Interested parties may have climate change-related requirements (Amd 1:2024)

iso27001_clauses.title: Determining the scope of the information security management system
iso27001_clauses.summary: The organization shall determine the boundaries and applicability of the ISMS to establish its scope.
requirements: Consider external and internal issues from 4.1
Consider requirements from 4.2
Consider interfaces and dependencies between activities
Document the scope and make it available

iso27001_clauses.title: Information security management system
iso27001_clauses.summary: The organization shall establish, implement, maintain, and continually improve an ISMS, including the processes needed and their interactions.
requirements: Establish processes needed for the ISMS
Determine interactions between processes
Implement and maintain processes

iso27001_clauses.title: Leadership
iso27001_clauses.summary: Top management must demonstrate leadership and commitment, establish an information security policy, and assign roles, responsibilities, and authorities.
requirements: Demonstrate leadership and commitment
Establish, implement, and maintain information security policy
Assign and communicate responsibilities and authorities

iso27001_clauses.title: Leadership and commitment
iso27001_clauses.summary: Top management shall demonstrate leadership and commitment by taking accountability for ISMS effectiveness, ensuring policy and objectives are established, integrating ISMS into business processes, promoting continual improvement, and providing resources.
requirements: Take accountability for ISMS effectiveness
Ensure policy and objectives are established and compatible with strategic direction
Integrate ISMS requirements into business processes
Ensure resources are available
Communicate importance of effective information security management
Ensure ISMS achieves intended outcomes
Direct and support persons to contribute to ISMS effectiveness
Promote continual improvement

iso27001_clauses.title: Policy
iso27001_clauses.summary: Top management shall establish an information security policy appropriate to the organization's purpose and context, providing a framework for setting objectives, including commitments to satisfy requirements and continual improvement.
requirements: Establish policy appropriate to purpose and context
Include commitment to satisfy applicable requirements
Include commitment to continual improvement
Provide framework for setting objectives
Be available as documented information
Be communicated within organization
Be available to interested parties as appropriate

iso27001_clauses.title: Organizational roles, responsibilities and authorities
iso27001_clauses.summary: Top management shall ensure responsibilities and authorities for relevant roles are assigned, communicated, and understood.
requirements: Assign responsibilities and authorities for information security
Communicate responsibilities and authorities
Assign specific responsibility for ISMS conformity to ISO/IEC 27001 requirements
Assign responsibility for reporting on ISMS performance

iso27001_clauses.title: Planning
iso27001_clauses.summary: The organization shall take actions to address risks and opportunities, plan actions, and establish information security objectives and plans to achieve them.
requirements: Address risks and opportunities related to ISMS
Plan actions to address them
Establish information security objectives
Plan how to achieve objectives

iso27001_clauses.title: Actions to address risks and opportunities
iso27001_clauses.summary: The organization shall establish processes to determine risks and opportunities related to the ISMS that need to be addressed to give assurance the ISMS can achieve its intended outcomes, prevent or reduce undesired effects, and achieve continual improvement.
requirements: Establish information security risk assessment processes
Establish information security risk treatment processes
Consider issues from 4.1 and requirements from 4.2
Identify risks and opportunities
Assess risks using defined criteria
Compare with risk acceptance criteria
Select appropriate risk treatment options
Determine controls necessary to implement risk treatment options
Produce Statement of Applicability (SoA) listing necessary controls and justification for exclusions
Formulate risk treatment plan
Retain documented information

iso27001_clauses.title: Information security objectives and planning to achieve them
iso27001_clauses.summary: The organization shall establish information security objectives at relevant functions and levels. Objectives shall be consistent with policy, measurable, monitored, communicated, and updated.
requirements: Establish information security objectives for relevant functions and levels
Ensure objectives are consistent with information security policy
Make objectives measurable (if practicable)
Monitor objectives
Communicate objectives
Update objectives as appropriate
Maintain documented information on objectives
Determine what will be done
Determine resources required
Assign responsibility
Set timing for completion
Define how results will be evaluated

iso27001_clauses.title: Planning of changes
iso27001_clauses.summary: When the organization determines the need for changes to the ISMS, the changes shall be carried out in a planned manner.
requirements: Consider purpose of changes and potential consequences
Maintain integrity of ISMS
Ensure resources are available
Allocate or reallocate responsibilities and authorities

iso27001_clauses.title: Support
iso27001_clauses.summary: The organization must determine and provide resources needed for the ISMS, ensure persons are competent, establish awareness, determine communication, and control documented information.
requirements: Provide resources
Ensure competence of persons
Establish awareness
Determine communication
Control documented information

iso27001_clauses.title: Resources
iso27001_clauses.summary: The organization shall determine and provide the resources needed for the establishment, implementation, maintenance, and continual improvement of the ISMS.
requirements: Determine resources needed for ISMS
Provide resources

iso27001_clauses.title: Competence
iso27001_clauses.summary: The organization shall determine the necessary competence of persons doing work under its control that affects its information security performance, ensure these persons are competent, take actions to acquire necessary competence, and retain documented information as evidence.
requirements: Determine necessary competence of persons affecting information security performance
Ensure persons are competent based on education, training, or experience
Take actions to acquire necessary competence
Evaluate effectiveness of actions taken
Retain documented information as evidence of competence

iso27001_clauses.title: Awareness
iso27001_clauses.summary: The organization shall ensure that persons doing work under its control are aware of the information security policy, their contribution to ISMS effectiveness, and implications of not conforming to ISMS requirements.
requirements: Ensure awareness of information security policy
Ensure awareness of contribution to ISMS effectiveness
Ensure awareness of implications of not conforming

iso27001_clauses.title: Communication
iso27001_clauses.summary: The organization shall determine the need for internal and external communications relevant to the ISMS, including what, when, with whom, how, and who communicates.
requirements: Determine what to communicate
Determine when to communicate
Determine with whom to communicate
Determine how to communicate
Determine who communicates

iso27001_clauses.title: Documented information
iso27001_clauses.summary: The ISMS shall include documented information required by ISO/IEC 27001 and determined by the organization as necessary for effectiveness. Creation, update, and control of documented information must be managed.
requirements: Include documented information required by ISO/IEC 27001
Include documented information determined necessary for ISMS effectiveness
Ensure appropriate identification and description (title, date, author, reference number)
Ensure appropriate format and media
Ensure review and approval for suitability and adequacy
Control documented information (distribution, access, retrieval, use, storage, preservation, version control, retention, disposition)
Manage documented information of external origin
Prevent unintended use of obsolete documented information

iso27001_clauses.title: Operation
iso27001_clauses.summary: The organization must plan, implement, and control processes needed to meet ISMS requirements, and assess and treat information security risks.
requirements: Plan, implement, and control operational processes
Perform information security risk assessments
Implement information security risk treatment plan
Manage changes

iso27001_clauses.title: Operational planning and control
iso27001_clauses.summary: The organization shall plan, implement, and control processes to meet ISMS requirements, establish criteria, control processes per criteria, maintain documented information, and control planned changes.
requirements: Plan, implement, and control processes to meet ISMS requirements
Establish criteria for processes
Control processes in accordance with criteria
Maintain documented information to have confidence processes were carried out as planned
Control planned changes and review consequences of unintended changes
Ensure outsourced processes are controlled

iso27001_clauses.title: Information security risk assessment
iso27001_clauses.summary: The organization shall perform information security risk assessments at planned intervals or when significant changes occur.
requirements: Apply defined risk assessment process
Identify risks associated with loss of confidentiality, integrity, and availability
Analyze risks using defined criteria
Evaluate risks against risk acceptance criteria
Retain documented information of risk assessment results

iso27001_clauses.title: Information security risk treatment
iso27001_clauses.summary: The organization shall implement the information security risk treatment plan, retain documented information, and update the Statement of Applicability.
requirements: Implement risk treatment plan
Apply appropriate risk treatment options
Determine controls necessary to implement options
Update Statement of Applicability
Retain documented information of risk treatment results

iso27001_clauses.title: Performance evaluation
iso27001_clauses.summary: The organization must monitor, measure, analyze, and evaluate its information security performance, conduct internal audits, and perform management reviews.
requirements: Monitor, measure, analyze, and evaluate information security performance
Conduct internal audits
Perform management reviews

iso27001_clauses.title: Monitoring, measurement, analysis and evaluation
iso27001_clauses.summary: The organization shall determine what needs to be monitored and measured, methods, when results shall be analyzed and evaluated, and retain documented information.
requirements: Determine what needs to be monitored and measured
Determine methods for monitoring, measurement, analysis, and evaluation
Determine when monitoring and measuring shall be performed
Determine when results shall be analyzed and evaluated
Evaluate information security performance and ISMS effectiveness
Retain documented information as evidence

iso27001_clauses.title: Internal audit
iso27001_clauses.summary: The organization shall conduct internal audits at planned intervals to provide information on whether the ISMS conforms to its own requirements and ISO/IEC 27001, and is effectively implemented and maintained.
requirements: Conduct internal audits at planned intervals
Determine if ISMS conforms to organization's own requirements and ISO/IEC 27001
Determine if ISMS is effectively implemented and maintained
Establish audit programme
Define audit criteria and scope for each audit
Select auditors and conduct audits to ensure objectivity and impartiality
Report results to relevant management
Retain documented information

iso27001_clauses.title: Management review
iso27001_clauses.summary: Top management shall review the ISMS at planned intervals to ensure its continuing suitability, adequacy, and effectiveness.
requirements: Review ISMS at planned intervals
Consider status of actions from previous reviews
Consider changes in external and internal issues (including climate change, Amd 1:2024)
Consider information security performance
Consider feedback from interested parties
Consider audit results
Consider risk assessment results and risk treatment plan status
Consider opportunities for improvement
Outputs include decisions related to improvement opportunities
Outputs include any need for changes to ISMS
Outputs include resource needs
Retain documented information as evidence

iso27001_clauses.title: Improvement
iso27001_clauses.summary: The organization must determine opportunities for improvement, react to nonconformities, take corrective action, and continually improve the suitability, adequacy, and effectiveness of the ISMS.
requirements: Determine opportunities for improvement
React to nonconformities and take corrective action
Continually improve ISMS

iso27001_clauses.title: Continual improvement
iso27001_clauses.summary: The organization shall continually improve the suitability, adequacy, and effectiveness of the ISMS.
requirements: Continually improve ISMS
Consider results of analysis and evaluation
Consider outputs from management review

iso27001_clauses.title: Nonconformity and corrective action
iso27001_clauses.summary: When a nonconformity occurs, the organization shall react, take action to control and correct it, deal with consequences, evaluate need for action to eliminate causes, implement any action needed, review effectiveness of corrective action, and make changes to ISMS if necessary.
requirements: React to nonconformity, take action to control and correct it
Deal with consequences
Evaluate need for action to eliminate causes
Review and analyze nonconformity
Determine causes
Determine if similar nonconformities exist or could occur
Implement any action needed
Review effectiveness of corrective action
Update risks and opportunities if necessary
Make changes to ISMS if necessary
Retain documented information
